task: Copyedit this obituary notice about an entirely fictional person only if a meaningful correction is needed. Preserve its restrained warmth, source attribution, and private-service boundary. The source does not give an age or cause of death. Return the notice unchanged if it is already accurate and suitable for a community newspaper.
input: Edrin Vale, a bellmaker who led open workshops at Brass Lane Workshop, has died, according to the family's remembrance programme. The programme records the death on Monday but gives no cause. "He made time for the slow question," it says. The family remembrance will be private. The notice does not announce a public service.
